upstreamFrontmatter.name: git-master
upstreamFrontmatter.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations: atomic commits, rebase/squash/fixup, and history search (blame, bisect, log -S, reflog). Load it before running git yourself, or pass load_skills=['git-master'] to the task that commits. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

adaptations: Restricted to user-selected local/browser/Obsidian execution; cloud, remote-provider and foreign-runtime branches disabled.
Russian discovery metadata and task-scoped invocation policy; original descriptions retained in upstreamFrontmatter.
